fusions.name: Lancing Heel
fusions.desc: A heel-kick that deals 20 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more for each one. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt, and the target is 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Foul Lather
fusions.desc: Flings lather across a 4-tile cone, dealing 12 damage and knocking everything caught 2.5 tiles back. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Enervated] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sweat It Out
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises 25% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitter Second Wind
fusions.desc: When a condition on you runs out, you restore 10 stamina. Once every 6 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.
